segments.name: Crude oil tankers
segments.description: Operates a fleet of crude oil tankers for charter customers, with a secondary activity of providing technical management services.
segments.evidence: DHT's primary business is operating a fleet of crude oil tankers, with a secondary activity of providing technical management services.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company charter hire for transporting crude oil, with some vessels operating in the spot market at fluctuating rates.
revenueModel.evidence: Our ability to charter our vessels and the charter rates payable under any new charters will depend upon, among other things, the conditions in the tanker market at that time.
